item.title: Bizarrap & Myke Towers’ ‘BZRP Music Session #42/66,’ More: Vote for the Best New Latin Music Release This Week
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's Latin music update. We're breaking down the hottest new releases, curated by the experts at Billboard Latin and Billboard Español.
[Short music transition]
Host: First up, Argentinian producer Bizarrap just dropped his first music session of the year, featuring Puerto Rican artist Myke Towers. "BZRP Music Session #42/66" is a two-part collaboration that showcases Towers' melodic rapping style and Bizarrap's signature bass-heavy beats.
[Clip of "BZRP Music Session #42/66" plays]
Host: The session is a love letter to Puerto Rico, with Towers paying homage to his roots and rapping about his elevated lifestyle. And in the second part of the collaboration, we get the highly-anticipated track "Boobytrap" - a trap-leaning rap song that's all about Towers' newfound respect in the industry.
[Clip of "Boobytrap" plays]
Host: But that's not all - other artists like Hermanos Espinoza, Kane Rodriguez, Fuerza Régida, and Mariangela have also released new music this week. And speaking of new music, have you voted in our New Music Latin poll yet? Feid's "El Moco Verde" is currently in the lead, but you can still cast your vote and make your voice heard.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's it for this week's update. Give these new releases a spin and let us know what you think. Don't forget to vote in our poll before it closes on Monday, June 29th. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time.
